headline: When to Call a Professional for a Custom Shower Bench Installation
articleBody:
Shower benches endure constant moisture and significant weight, making proper structural framing and waterproofing essential. Knowing when to bring in an experienced general contractor protects your home from costly subfloor rot and structural failures.

Signs It Is Time to Call a Professional:
- You are converting a standard tub into a walk-in shower and need to determine how a bench impacts the floor pan drainage slope.
- You need a heavy load-bearing bench engineered to meet accessibility or aging-in-place guidelines safely.
- You discover soft spots, loose tiles, or persistent moisture at the base of an existing shower bench.
- The bench layout requires tying into existing load-bearing walls or altering shower framing.
- You are uncertain how to achieve a watertight seal where the horizontal seat intersects the vertical shower walls.

When Professional Guidance Helps
Even if finished tile looks flawless, an unsealed seam or improper base can trap water, leading to hidden mold and joist damage. A licensed professional ensures the bench frame is solidly secured, fully tied into the shower pan liner, and sloped correctly for positive drainage.
